text: The Manager, Connected Community, Technology Services, and the Management Consultant, Technology Services, will give a presentation on the Digital Infrastructure Plan, which will guide the use of data and technology by the City of Toronto. Special attention in the presentation will be paid to bias and discrimination, and First Nations Data Sovereignty considerations, as it relates to digital infrastructure. Public consultations on the Digital Infrastructure Plan started in September and continue into October.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Chief Technology Officer to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the work on the Digital Infrastructure Plan.
